summary: Inside the elevator, Trinity and Neo begin preparing an explosive device. Trinity immediately drops down and opens the suitcase, wiring a plastique and napalm bomb. Neo then hits the emergency stop, pulls down part of the false ceiling, and finds the elevator shaft access panel. The scene shows them setting up both a bomb and an escape route out of the elevator.
